scope: Isolated v2 adapter, original ROS/Nav2/native/vendor and all baseline reports unchanged
planner: Original ORCA proposal projected onto per-human support halfspaces and per-agent speed discs; fixed measured robot velocity
fault_handling: On fatal reply/socket loss, plugin publishes zero velocity and emits world Pause synchronously; terminal state re-pauses on Play. This is a simulation interlock, not physical braking.
acceptance: Both crossing sessions complete10s; opposed/narrow regressions complete10s; independent actual-pose/LiDAR audit and no overlap>5mm including teardown; fault interlock clock stable1.2s and re-paused after Play within1-2physics ticks; robot drift<=5mm from fault input.
